prompt: Which setup would let Sam use the same approach that worked in his trial without interfering with sign-in?
promptZh: 哪種安排能讓山姆沿用試玩時有效的方法，又不影響簽到？

options.text: Put the green board flat on the spare bench.
options.zh: 把綠色板平放在備用長椅上。
options.whyZh: 長椅與平放方式適合，但綠色組是圖文，用的不是山姆摸凸形狀的做法。

options.text: Hang the yellow board above the spare bench.
options.zh: 把黃色板掛在備用長椅上方。
options.whyZh: 選對可摸的組別，也沒妨礙簽到，但仍得一手舉卡、一手摸，無法沿用平放方法。

options.text: Put the yellow board flat on the little table.
options.zh: 把黃色板平放在小桌上。
options.whyZh: 板子與放法正確，但小桌才是家長簽到處。

options.text: Put the yellow board flat on the spare bench.
options.zh: 把黃色板平放在備用長椅上。
options.whyZh: 黃色組提供凸圖；平放才是山姆成功時的方法，備用長椅也不占用簽到處。

evidence:
The green set is just printed. The yellow set has just raised shapes you can feel, but Sam mixed up the star and the flower.
He took his glasses off for that round. He could match both shapes when he rested the board flat. On the wall he had to hold each card up with one hand and feel the mark with the other.
The little table is where parents sign in. The spare bench is clear and low enough. Could we set up a practice pair with no mark from the live game?
explanationZh: 黃色組提供凸圖；平放才是山姆成功時的方法，備用長椅也不占用簽到處。

vocabulary.note: raised 在這裡形容從表面凸出，手指可以沿著外形觸摸。
